metrics.mrr_definition: reciprocal rank of first chunk belonging to any required evidence group
metrics.ndcg_definition: binary required-chunk relevance with ideal count equal to number of required groups
metrics.primary: per-query required-evidence-group Recall@3 E minus B in explicit_history
metrics.required_group_rule: one page-level evidence unit remains one denominator group; hit if any acceptable chunk is retrieved

retrieval.mate_gate: strictly positive raw BM25 and present in shared candidate pool
retrieval.pair_boost_selection_source: prior opened V5 development and validation only
retrieval.recency_normalization: min-max publication year within the shared top-20 candidate pool
retrieval.tokenization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric regex with frozen stopword set

statistics.positive_claim_rule: effect > 0, p < 0.05, and CI lower bound > 0
statistics.primary_test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip permutation using dynamic programming

systems.C: if explicit-history disable recency; otherwise B
systems.D: always-on in-pool seed-lineage pairing on top of B
systems.E: if explicit-history disable recency and apply in-pool seed-lineage pairing; otherwise B
systems.F: E without pair boost; definitionally identical to C
